name: branding-labyrinth-monogram-with-spaced-wordmark
title: Labyrinth infinity monogram with dot-spaced wordmark
whatItIs: A black-and-white logo: a double circle of concentric maze-like lines forming an infinity shape, above 'V•E•S•P•E•R•A' with dots between letters. Below are applications on a paper bag against sculpted green and a letterpress business card on leather.
whatItMeans: Meditative, ritual and timeless; the maze suggests a journey inward and the spaced letters feel ceremonial.
techniques: Build a symbol from many parallel monoline strokes to create hypnotic depth.
Separate wordmark letters with bullets for rhythm and ceremony.
Design in strict black and white so it suits letterpress and stamping.
Show physical applications with strong material contrast (paper vs green plaster, leather).

vocabulary.definition: Drawn with strokes of uniform thickness.
Small dots used between letters or words.
A concentric maze pattern suggesting a path.
Printing that presses ink into thick paper.
